q: Our Gqeberha plant supplies a European carmaker. What carbon data do they usually ask for?
title: Gqeberha auto supplier carbon request
short: Usually Scope 1 and 2 for the plant, a footprint per part with material emissions, and a renewable electricity plan. Eskom power makes Scope 2 large, so record units and any wheeled renewable power or certificates separately. Give the period and factors.
audience: Automotive component suppliers in Gqeberha, Kariega and the Eastern Cape

ul: Scope 1 and 2 for the plant, per year.
A product carbon footprint for key parts.
A target or plan for renewable electricity.

p: Grid power in South Africa is coal heavy, so it often dominates the plant figure. Keep units from bills and any renewable supply contracts with their certificates.
Steel, aluminium and plastics bought in usually outweigh the plant's own energy; ask suppliers for figures.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
